name: sloe-data
description: Read-only licensed Sloe Data research on U.S. credit unions: financials, peer benchmarking, HMDA mortgage lending, CUSOs, mergers and regulatory data.

interface.shortDescription: Query licensed CU, HMDA and market data
interface.longDescription: Sloe Data gives Codex read-only access to its licensed research catalog through a hosted MCP server. Query full credit-union profiles, original Call Report fields, HMDA mortgage lending and history, CUSOs, CU acquisitions of banks, regulatory data, leadership and geographic markets. Installing the plugin does not grant a data license; connect a licensed Sloe Data account through browser-based OAuth approval.
defaultPrompt: Show the available Sloe Data research datasets.
Get HMDA mortgage lending and annual history for Navy Federal.
Compare credit unions and their CUSO and vendor relationships.
